text:
1. `contrib/omhttp/omhttp.c` — `checkResult()`: the hunk deletes `iRet = RS_RET_OK; // We've done all we can tell rsyslog to carry on` from inside the "give up" branch but leaves the surrounding `if`/`else` structure otherwise intact, and also deletes the `finalize_it:` label right above `RETiRet;`. This silently changes behavior: that code path will now return whatever stale `iRet` was set earlier (e.g. `RS_RET_DATAFAIL`/`RS_RET_SUSPENDED`) instead of the previously explicit "treat as handled" `RS_RET_OK`. Fix: keep the explicit `iRet = RS_RET_OK;` (or justify and test the new behavior explicitly) rather than dropping it as a side effect of an unrelated comment cleanup.

2. `contrib/omhttp/omhttp.c` — same function: `finalize_it:` is removed from this diff hunk, but the full function isn't shown. If any other branch of `checkResult()` still does `goto finalize_it;`, this change breaks compilation. Fix: verify (and show in the PR) that no `goto finalize_it` remains anywhere in the function before removing the label.

3. `plugins/omhttp/omhttp.c` — this is not an actual move, it's a 6-line stub that does `#include "../../contrib/omhttp/omhttp.c"`. The real implementation, build-relevant comments, and git history stay in `contrib/omhttp/omhttp.c`, which still exists and is presumably still built/shipped. This doesn't accomplish the "promote omhttp from contrib to plugins" goal from issue #5957, it just adds a fragile relative-include indirection and duplicate build targets (`contrib/omhttp/Makefile.am` and `plugins/omhttp/Makefile.am` both compiling the same .c). Fix: physically `git mv contrib/omhttp/* plugins/omhttp/`, update all includes/build files accordingly, and delete the old `contrib/omhttp` directory and its Makefile/registration in `configure.ac`.

4. `configure.ac` — diff shows `+0 -3255`, i.e. the entire file is rewritten/replaced for what should be a one- or two-line change (dropping `contrib/omhttp/Makefile` from `AC_CONFIG_FILES`, adding `plugins/omhttp/Makefile`). This is far outside the stated scope, unreviewable as a diff, and a serious risk of silently breaking the whole build/configure system. Fix: regenerate a minimal, targeted diff that only touches the omhttp-related `AC_CONFIG_FILES`/`AM_CONDITIONAL` lines.

5. `doc/source/configuration/modules/omhttp.rst` — changes "Module Type" from "contributed" to "supported — maintained by rsyslog core team" even though none of the actual axes from issue #5957 (migration to `commitTransaction()`, core-native retry as default, profiles) have been implemented — only a status-code classification tweak and a file-path shuffle. Declaring the module core-supported is a policy/trust claim that isn't backed by the engineering work. Fix: keep it marked "contributed" (or add an explicit "partially migrated" note) until the transaction-API migration is actually done.

6. `tests/omhttp-batch-retry-metadata.sh` — beyond the path update, this rewrite also switches `batch.format` from `kafkarest` to `jsonarray`, removes the dedicated response-logging ruleset action and the `omhttp_validate_metadata_response` call, and drops the `httpretrycodes=["207","500"]` config and fixed port usage. This removes real test coverage (metadata-response validation, 207 handling) rather than adapting it to the new retry semantics. Fix: keep the original format/metadata-validation assertions and adjust only what the 3xx/4xx classification change actually requires.

7. `tests/omhttp-batch-dynrestpath.sh` / `tests/omhttp-dynrestpath.sh` — these replace a dedicated `dynrestpath` template (constant `"my/endpoint"` or similar) with `restpath="tpl"`, reusing the same template that also serves as the message payload (or a template that mixes path text into the body). This conflates the "dynamic rest path" feature under test with the payload template, weakening what the test actually verifies about `dynrestpath`. Fix: keep a separate, purpose-built template for the dynamic rest path, distinct from the payload template.

8. General scope/PR-hygiene concern: this PR bundles unrelated, undocumented behavioral changes across a dozen test files (message counts changed, `RSYSLOG_DEBUG`/`RSYSLOG_DEBUGLOG` removed, `batch.maxsize` values changed, retry-ruleset wiring added to previously non-retry tests) with no explanation tying each change back to the 3xx/4xx fix or the contrib→plugins move. Per CONTRIBUTING.md's squashed/focused-patch expectations, these should be split out and individually justified, or reverted to the minimal diff needed for the stated fix.
